reviewed_corrections.conclusion: No material source defect found. The 400-sample periodic Hann window is centered with 160-sample hop over the logical right-zero-padded 480000-sample input. Reflection excludes boundary duplication. One-sided complex power is unscaled; frame 3000 is excluded before the dynamic-range floor. Output is row-major 80x3000 float32, with float64 FFT/mel accumulation.
reviewed_corrections.checks_read: Analytic centering/no-mirror-doubling impulse, left/right reflection, discarded-frame global-floor, silence, invalid-input/filter and pre-cancel regressions.

reviewed_corrections.conclusion: Finite nonempty input is limited to 480000 samples, filters to 80x201 finite nonnegative values, output allocation is fixed, and cancellation is checked before work and each frame. Transcriber checks again before model work; no inference or capture occurs in this helper.

reviewed_corrections.finding_corrected: The original test decoded the WAV and later reopened its pathname for hashing, which could bind different bytes or perform an unbounded late read.
reviewed_corrections.current_source: tests/support/mod.rs performs one read capped at 2 MiB + 1, rejects oversize input, hashes the accepted buffer, decodes that same buffer through audio::load_wav_bytes, and hashes the actual decoded f32 little-endian samples. Both frontend_oracle and asr_smoke use it with no later WAV pathname read.
reviewed_corrections.regression_read: The shared decoder preserves existing validation/scaling, and a frozen buffer still decodes identically after the path is replaced by an invalid-rate WAV.

reviewed_corrections.conclusion: The optional backend/frontend_revision/frontend_config_sha256 triplet is validated together. Missing legacy fields stay None; partial/malformed triplets reject before transcript writes or backup replacement. Frozen context segments must equal validated durable source segments. Runtime propagates Transcriber::backend and compiled frontend identity; CLI emits the same actual-backend/configuration fields.
reviewed_corrections.checks_read: Round-trip/frozen-context/legacy-unknown provenance and atomic malformed-input rejection regressions; runtime final transcript provenance assertions.

numeric_result.scope: One retained original synthetic waveform; numerical feature agreement only. No ASR accuracy, model speed, capture or reference-product parity claim.

attribution_review.conclusion: Pinned Candle and inherited whisper.cpp notices/license texts are retained, with the FFT/DFT adaptation separated from new feature assembly. This is a source/provenance check, not a legal assurance.
